title: Gemma joins anonymous text generation
summary:
One PR brought a new anonymous text model, reduced auth-related database contention, and moved text analytics into the cache worker.

Added `gemma-roblox`, backed by Gemma 2 9B IT Fast, with tool support and a 1,024-token output configuration.

Disabled per-user metric writes at several call sites and added an index for API token lookups, addressing database contention affecting authentication requests.

Moved text-generation success and error analytics from the text server to the cache worker, with events for requests, cache activity, generation, and failures.

highlights.title: Gemma for anonymous text
highlights.text: Try `gemma-roblox` for text generation with tool support and up to 1,024 output tokens. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gemma-roblox).
